post.description: Server-sent events, each with a monotonic `id`: `message.started`, `status` {stage: queued|rewriting|retrieving|generating}, `reasoning.delta` (only when `/config.features.reasoning`), `answer.delta` (Markdown with inline `[n]` markers), `answer.citations`, `conversation.updated`, `turn.superseded`, then `message.completed` {finishReason: stop|length|no_evidence|cancelled} or `error`. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s. Resending the same turn replays its stream; a different body with the same key is 409 `idempotency_conflict`. A turn still answering is 409 `turn_in_progress`; one that has not started answering is superseded (its stream gets `turn.superseded`) and answered together with this one.
